q: What topics does Zachary Leifer speak on?
a: Zachary Leifer speaks on AI strategy, investment governance, organizational readiness and value realization, as well as commercial growth and customer economics, customer data platforms and personalization, digital transformation, marketing technology and the working relationship between marketing, technology and finance. His talks examine how leaders define business outcomes, assess readiness, align teams and measure results. They draw on his executive experience in gaming, hospitality, wagering and eCommerce and on his Harvard Business School Advanced Management Program capstone research, the Leadership Impact Project.

q: Is Zachary Leifer available for keynote speaking engagements?
a: Yes. Zachary Leifer is available for keynotes, executive panels, leadership roundtables, board sessions, workshops, virtual events and podcasts. He is based in Las Vegas, Nevada, and available nationally and internationally.

q: What perspective does Zachary Leifer bring as a speaker?
a: Zachary Leifer has held vice president roles in both digital marketing and corporate information technology at Las Vegas Sands, a Fortune 500 company, and has served as Chief Marketing Officer and Chief Commercial Officer. His talks are grounded in results from those roles, including 67% revenue growth at 1/ST Technology during his tenure as Chief Marketing Officer and $36M in incremental direct-channel revenue at The Venetian. His perspective on AI draws on governing earlier investments in big data, digital transformation and enterprise technology, where value depended on the same conditions: a defined business outcome, accountable ownership, organizational readiness, protected resources and credible measurement.

q: What industries does Zachary Leifer speak to?
a: Zachary Leifer's operating experience spans integrated resorts and gaming, hospitality, sports wagering and horse racing, iGaming, eCommerce, luxury retail and sports media. His talks are designed for audiences in those industries and for private equity, financial services and any sector where AI strategy, customer data and commercial growth are on the agenda.

q: How can I book Zachary Leifer to speak at my event?
a: To book Zachary Leifer for a conference, executive event, podcast or panel, email zacharyleifer@gmail.com with the event date, format, expected audience, session topic and timing so he can assess the fit. Inquiries about executive roles or prospective board roles can go to the same address. For consulting and commercial advisory engagements, contact State of Mind Strategies at somstrategies.com.

q: Where has Zachary Leifer spoken or presented?
a: Zachary Leifer's past appearances include a World Tote Association presentation, Digital Transformation in the Age of the Customer (2020); the NC Labs podcast, Awesome in Action (2021); and a presentation of his Leadership Impact Project research to fellow participants in the Harvard Business School Advanced Management Program (2026).
